decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line highlight [ev-522012cd49c1]: Flux now watches for changes in ConfigMaps and Secrets that Kustomization and HelmRelease reference. It does not say whether watching is on by default or must be turned on per object. If it is opt-in, the consequence would be "none", not "behavior-change". The proposed statement also claims that changes trigger reconciliation instead of waiting for the interval, which the evidence does not say. The rest of the section [ev-bd329a64ec5d] lists other features and does not settle this. To decide, we need the upgrade guide or docs for this feature, stating how it is enabled and what changes for existing objects.
